integrity: Proof is universal and uses classical digit-sum identities; executable checks are finite corroboration only. Literature comparison carries residual unindexed-source risk.
scientific_limitations: Determines only the p-adic valuation in the stated interval and at the next multiplier; does not classify complete integer GCDs or later rows. Motivating maximal-valuation theorem and single-index prime-power-minus-one congruence are prior art; novelty claim is the simultaneous all-selected-coefficient interval and its sharp zero boundary. Independent assessment remains unperformed.
title: A maximal \(p\)-adic plateau and sharp collapse for selected binomial GCDs at \(p^r-1\)
